assemble_rcnn_outputs_by_name: assemble caffe2 model tensor outputs into detectron2 Instances with boxes, scores, masks, and keypoints
convert_batched_inputs_to_c2_format: convert detectron2 batched inputs to caffe2 format with padded NCHW tensors and im_info metadata
set_caffe2_compatible_tensor_mode: enable or disable caffe2 compatible tensor mode on all Caffe2Compatible submodules of a model
Caffe2GeneralizedRCNN_forward: run a traced forward pass of a patched GeneralizedRCNN model using caffe2-compatible operations
Caffe2RetinaNet_encode_additional_info: encode RetinaNet inference parameters like score threshold, NMS threshold, and anchor generator config into protobuf args
